name: Lectus operis
gloss: the read one, of the work
wiring_note: The readout sits alone at the READ stage, so no seam exists. Add `validation` and it acquires one: validation is read.order 2 and an abstention there must END the read rather than hand control down. That handoff cost 18 points in x16.

fuel.law: IV. The same seat on different fuel is a different organism. Fuel is part of the creature, never chosen at run time.

receipt.claim: the answer was already present and had no way out
receipt.caveat: rarer than it looks. Re-scored on two batteries after the readout learned two more dialects: +0 recovered on counting, +1 on traps.
